conflicts.topic: whether a Finnish personal identity code is needed to get strong electronic identification from a bank
conflicts.aQuote: To be granted a strong electronic means of identification, you must have a Finnish personal identity code and be entered in the Population Information System
conflicts.bQuote: You can obtain online banking credentials and a strong electronic ID when you become a customer, provided you have a valid identity document required for this purpose
conflicts.note: Poppankki says a Finnish personal identity code and Population Information System registration are required for strong identification; Nordea only mentions a valid identity document and does not say whether a personal identity code is also needed.
conflicts.whatToDo: Nordea does not rule out a personal identity code requirement, so these are probably not incompatible. Banks set their own onboarding rules, so ask your chosen bank directly before the appointment whether you need a personal identity code, and which documents to bring. Registering with DVV to get the code first is the safer route, and you should ask explicitly for codes that work for strong electronic identification, not only for online banking.
